goal: Compile validated Provider planning proposals and raw user intent into one grounded canonical GoalSpec with bounded requirement replan.
acceptance_criteria: The accepted requirements_planning artifact is schema-validated, identity-bound, and consumed by a generic canonical GoalSpec compiler without gaining canonical authority.
Unknown Chinese and cross-domain goals compile non-empty grounded capabilities and workstreams while simple goals remain proportionate.
Explicit constraints and outcome anchors are preserved; ungrounded additions, cloud injection, scope inflation, and proxy substitutions are rejected or downgraded.
Insufficient proposals enter bounded WAITING_REQUIREMENT_REPLAN and resume the same run through the single Provider scheduler.
Live, codex_surrogate, and deterministic_replay share the compiler; frozen partial acceptance, Product Design Governance, candidate finalization, benchmarks, and delivery gates remain unchanged.
Source identity records HEAD, dirty state/diff hash, Agent Kit package identity, plugin version/source hash, changed canonical module hashes, and contract hashes.

quality_metrics.measure: canonical fields with accepted provenance and preserved explicit constraints
quality_metrics.target: all core capabilities, workstreams, constraints, and acceptance anchors grounded; zero silent goal degradation
quality_metrics.method: schema, provenance, adversarial proposal, and cross-domain compiler tests

quality_metrics.target: insufficient proposals emit structured feedback, preserve attempts, and stop at the configured maximum
quality_metrics.method: surrogate/replay integration tests and accounting inspection

quality_metrics.target: all scoped, related, guard, kernel, and py_compile checks pass with zero Provider/network calls
quality_metrics.method: targeted and related pytest profiles plus hash guards

prevention: Define proposal and canonical schemas before compiler implementation.
Keep proposal authority separate from canonical requirement authority.
assurance: Review every modified module against the single scheduler and post-build boundary.
Exercise unfamiliar domains and malicious proposals, not only the motivating media goal.
control: Run schema, unit, integration, cross-mode, kernel, guard, and py_compile checks.
Run two fresh zero-provider requirement-lane smokes.
improvement: Record whether bounded replan replaces terminal keyword-recognizer failure without overcomplicating simple goals.

interface_expectations: requirements_planning response remains a Provider proposal and is never copied into canonical authority without grounding validation
run_requirement_decision receives the validated planning artifact through the existing production route
WAITING_REQUIREMENT_REPLAN remains a workflow state, not an EvidenceStatus or candidate repair

feedback: Acceptance remains NEEDS_REWORK because the required kernel-contract test update is itself listed in the unchanged Product Design frozen-boundary guard.
Generic GoalSpec compilation, grounded proposal ingestion, bounded same-run replan, and both fresh smokes passed.

worked: Formal request/submit/resume reached product_design with zero Provider and network calls.
Structured proposal grounding removed the open-domain keyword recognizer bottleneck.
did_not_work: Repository policies require changing tests/test_kernel_contract.py while the frozen Product Design rule guard rejects any change to that same path.
experiments: Resolve the contract-test versus frozen-guard ownership conflict in a separately authorized governance change.
